appraisal_events.evidence: ce garçon, qui passait et avec raison pour si mauvais sujet, était tellement rempli de l'âme qui avait décoré Saint-André-des-Champs... qu'il avait pour soulever la tête de ma tante sur son oreiller la mine naïve et zélée des petits anges des bas-reliefs
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite his reputation as a delinquent, Théodore's tender, reverent care of the ailing aunt is narrated as an unexpected, almost angelic elevation.

appraisal_events.evidence: cette sorte de crainte... avait développé chez [Françoise] un sentiment que nous avions pris pour de la haine et qui était de la vénération et de l'amour. Sa véritable maîtresse... sa souveraine, son mystérieux et tout-puissant monarque n'était plus.
appraisal_events.explanation: In death, tante Léonie is revealed to have held supreme, sovereign status in Françoise's devoted inner world, witnessed by fifteen days of uninterrupted, sacrificial care; Françoise's own feared subservience is reframed as veneration and love.

status_effects.explanation: His bad-boy reputation is locally overturned by his genuinely tender, reverent devotion to the dying aunt.
She is revealed, through Françoise's unwavering devotion during her final illness, to have held sovereign standing in Françoise's world.
What had seemed like fearful resentment is recast as deep veneration and love, casting Françoise more sympathetically.
